title: MapSPAM 2020 V1r2 (SSA) — raw CSV release
description: The raw MapSPAM CSV release, as distinct from the Atlas-harmonised rasters. Kept separate because the two are fetched from different prefixes and used by different code.

origin.license_note: CC-BY-4.0 verified 2026-10-08 from two independent sources: the CGSpace item 5736e3ff-aadc-4999-8922-8bac50b1c916 and the Harvard Dataverse API for doi:10.7910/DVN/Z0HK7R (license href creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/, v1.0, published 2026-01-07). This is the Alliance's MapSPAM2020_AdaptationAtlas_SSA, a DIFFERENT dataset from IFPRI's global SPAM2020 v2r2 that the CDH record `spam2020` describes and licenses CC-BY-SA-4.0. Plain attribution, no share-alike, so nothing propagates into the derived exposure or hazard_exposure products (#37).

transfer.rationale: On Atlas S3; fetched per host.
